summary: win_basename returns the last component of a Windows path, including UNC paths that follow UNC syntax.
questions: How do I get a file name from a Windows path?
Does win_basename work with UNC paths?

answer_card.title: win_basename filter
answer_card.answer_md: `{{ path | win_basename }}` returns the last component of a Windows path. UNC paths work if they follow UNC syntax.
